modes.name: Hyperkinetic Projectiles
modes.desc: This mode blocks various fast moving physical objects, such as bullets, blunt weapons, meteors and other.

modes.name: Photonic Dispersion
modes.desc: This mode blocks majority of light. This includes beam weaponry and most of the visible light spectrum.

modes.name: Electro-Magnetic Shielding
modes.desc: This mode blocks various high-power emissions like electrical storms.

modes.name: Humanoid Lifeforms
modes.desc: This mode blocks various humanoid lifeforms. Does not affect fully synthetic humanoids.

modes.name: Silicon Lifeforms
modes.desc: This mode blocks various silicon based lifeforms.

modes.name: Unknown Lifeforms
modes.desc: This mode blocks various other non-humanoid and non-silicon lifeforms. Typical uses include blocking carps.

modes.name: Atmospheric Containment
modes.desc: This mode blocks air flow and acts as atmosphere containment.

modes.name: Hull Shielding
modes.desc: This mode recalibrates the field to cover surface of the installation instead of projecting a bubble shaped field.

modes.name: Adaptive Field Harmonics
modes.desc: This mode modulates the shield harmonic frequencies, allowing the field to adapt to various damage types.

modes.name: Multi-Dimensional Field Warp
modes.desc: Recalibrates the field projection array to increase the vertical height of the field, allowing it's usage on multi-deck stations or ships.
